shortDescription: Create/delete private network on phoenixNAP Bare Metal Cloud.

options.name: cidr
options.description: IP range associated with this private network in CIDR notation.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of this private network.

options.name: force
options.description: parameter controlling advanced features availability. Currently applicable for networking. It is advised to use with caution since it might lead to unhealthy setups.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of this private network. Once a network is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: location_default
options.description: Identifies network as the default private network for the specified location. Once a network is created, it cannot be modified through a playbook

options.name: name
options.description: The friendly name of this private network.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The VLAN that will be assigned to this network.
